feature.label: GAMA Developer Tools
feature.description: Tools for the developers of GAMA, available in a "GAMA" menu of the Eclipse IDE: "Get started..." guides prerequisite checks, JDK 25 configuration, source installation, building and launching; wizards for new GAMA plugins (standard layout, annotation processor configured, integration in the build), skills, operators, actions, types and test models; "Clean GAMA plugins" resets the annotation processor and rebuilds; a configuration checker with quick fixes; a report of undocumented and untested GAML elements; the rebuild of the processor jar, a package dependency graph and native local releases without installing Maven.
